items.title: Pas de raison de voir Anderlecht favori contre Hammarby ? "Mais nos supporters peuvent faire la différence"
items.summary: Le Sporting d'Anderlecht disputera déjà une rencontre particulièrement cruciale ce jeudi soir face à Hammarby, au deuxième tour préliminaire de l'Europa League. Cependant, l'entraîneur portugais Vitor Bruno n'endosse pas vraiment le rôle de favori et la joue justement très prudemment.

items.title: Experimental Liverpool down Wrexham thanks to Rio Ngumoha’s deflected strike
items.summary: Substitute’s 75th-minute shot gives Liverpool 1-0 win in New York Chances few and far between in pre-season friendly that fails to ignite Liverpool turned the Empire State Building red when launching a new away kit on Tuesday but neither they nor Wrexham could illuminate Yankee Stadium 24 hours later. It was rough in the diamond, although Rio Ngumoha’s deflected goal made it two wins out of two for Andoni Iraola on his first pre-season tour as Liverpool head coach. Ngumoha, a second half substitute who Iraola deployed on the right, satisfied the majority of a 42,204 crowd with a 75th-minute shot that looped in off Wrexham defender Lewis Brunt. Wrexham’s Hollywood co-owners Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney (now simply Rob Mac) were in attendance for what the former had labelled a “punch-me moment” but in truth few blows were traded at the iconic baseball stadium. items.title: WSL brings back Sunday evening kick-offs after indifferent viewing figures
items.summary: Move part of an overhaul of its broadcast strategy Sunday evening games were dropped last season The Women’s Super League will bring back Sunday evening kick-offs this season as part of an overhaul of its broadcast strategy after indifferent viewing figures last season. The Guardian has learned that the WSL will offer six different TV slots to broadcasters after releasing its fixtures for the 2026-27 campaign later on Thursday in a significant change from last season, when the majority of televised games took place on Saturday and Sunday lunchtimes. items.title: Uefa calls emergency meeting as opposition to Fifa plan hardens
items.summary: 55 members to meet on Thursday to coordinate response ‘Uefa knows there is significant and growing opposition’ Uefa has called an emergency ­meeting of its 55 members for Thursday afternoon to discuss a coordinated response to Gianni Infantino’s plan to sell off stakes in the World Cup to private investors. A European boycott of Fifa tournaments is among the options under consideration. As the next major event in the Fifa calendar, a boycott of next year’s Women’s World Cup has been ­mentioned in preliminary ­discussions, although there would be a reluctance in some quarters to make the women’s game suffer as a consequence of a protest against Fifa proposals that primarily revolve around ­monetising the men’s World Cup and Club World Cup. Continue reading...

items.title: ‘I’m very sorry’: Mancini apologises after being reappointed as Italy head coach
items.summary: Mancini quit Italy job to take over Saudi Arabia in 2023 ‘Some will be against me … maybe people will forgive’ Roberto Mancini issued an apology in his first public comments after being reappointed as the Italy head coach, three years after he abandoned the same job for a lucrative contract with Saudi Arabia. “I’m very sorry,” Mancini said. “It was like losing the woman of your life. And it means you did something that shouldn’t have been done. So I’m sorry, very sorry also for everything that happened over these last three years … I’m going to try to bring the national team back where it belongs.” Continue reading...

items.title: Fifa opens disciplinary proceedings against Argentina over Falklands banner and final chaos
items.summary: Players held banner after semi-final against England Paredes and Molina investigated over brawl after final Fifa has opened disciplinary ­proceedings against Argentina over the Falkland Islands banner ­displayed after their World Cup semi‑final win against England in Atlanta. items.title: Niet alleen positie van T1 vacant: Antwerp wil technische staf nog verder verstevigen
items.summary: Het lijkt onvoorstelbaar zo kort voor de competitiestart, maar Antwerp heeft nog steeds geen nieuwe trainer. De redenen hiervoor zijn uiteraard wel bekend. Antwerp hoopt naast een trainer binnenkort ook een nieuwe videoanalist te verwelkomen. Er is dus nog werk om de technische staf vorm te geven.

items.title: Anderlecht n'a pas tardé : la quatrième recrue de l'été déjà présentée

L'ailier finlandais est attendu à Bruxelles pour passer sa visite médicale et signer son contrat, lui qui a disputé 28 rencontres avec les Glasgow Rangers la saison dernière.
